cuerpo: In January 2003, the 111th session of the Executive Board of the World Health Organization will nominate a candidate for the Director-General of WHO, for the period from July 2003 to July 2008, to be elected at the World Health Assembly in May 2003. I have today informed the Chairman of the Executive Board that I will not be a candidate for this nomination. When I took office in July 1998 I spelt out my vision for WHO and what I saw as our priorities ahead. I emphasized my ambition to help anchor health firmly on the international development agenda. I stressed the priority of improving the health of the poor. I underlined the need for WHO to reach out and mobilize a range of partners, based on solid evidence. I indicated how I envisaged a process of needed change and reform of the Organization. Supported by our Member States, I feel we have made significant and substantial progress towards these objectives. Throughout my term as Director-General I have had a perspective for our policies and work that goes beyond the limits of any term.
